# `group`

A body of people: its roles, who in it may order whom, and what it holds toward other groups from the start (15 §9.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `roles` (object, name → object [`RoleDef`](#roledef); optional): Its roles, by id.
- `collective` (string, or `null`; optional): The mind that decides for it (09 §8.1), as written: for the AI.
- `relations` (object, name → (object, name → number); optional): What it holds toward other groups (and itself) from the start: for each group, by id, the value of each relation kind, by id.
- `doc` (string; optional): What it is, for the reference.

<a id="roledef"></a>
### `RoleDef`

A role in a group (15 §9.2).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `orders` (list of string; optional): The roles of the same group whose members this role may give orders to.
- `spends` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether a member in this role may pay from what the group holds (16 §5.6).
